name: Esplora
overview: Poised for completion by December 2025, this residential gem reimagines urban sophistication with a perfect fusion of modern design, serene green spaces, and cutting-edge technology. Esplora features a range of thoughtfully designed studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, catering to individuals and families seeking comfort and elegance. Every detail reflects a commitment to quality, from its geometric façade to the Italian marble finishes in shared spaces. Esplora isn’t just a residence—it’s a statement of refined urban living in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing communities.
